rubric.role_summary: Remote US-based learning consultant supporting organizations with digital learning platform adoption, instructional strategy, change management, training, and use of Canvas and other Instructure products.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote US-based learning consultant supporting organizations with digital learning platform adoption, instructional strategy, change management, training, and use of Canvas and other Instructure products.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least three years of teaching or consulting experience, including experience with a digital learning environment.
- At least two years of Canvas experience.
- At least one year in an educational leadership position.
- Experience delivering presentations in an educational environment.
- Bachelor’s Degree in Instructional Technology or equivalent.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- More than two years of Canvas experience.
- Experience with other Instructure tools, including Studio, Catalog, Credentials, or Impact.
- More than one year in the specified educational leadership position.
- Master’s Degree in Educational Leadership or Instructional Technology.
- At least two years of Canvas experience, including creating Canvas courses responsive to and inclusive of teaching and learning needs in a digital learning environment.
- At least one year in an educational leadership position overseeing a team supporting pedagogical use of a learning and assessment management system.
- Experience leading change, building relationships, developing effective professional development programs, and rolling out a technology platform to a large organization.
- Current knowledge of technology adoption strategies, professional development protocols, and educational technology best practices.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: US (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
